predictions.articleTitle: Union Cosnoise vs Sedan Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Cosne Halt Sedan's Cup Surge?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Retain Draw / Away Win as the primary 90-minute direction, leaning toward CS Sedan Ardennes edging Union Cosnoise in a competitive cup tie.
possibilityAssessment: Primary Thesis: Draw / Away Win led by Sedan's 0.67 decayed cup conceding rate and 2:0 win over National 2 side Bourges Foot 18 (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Secondary Angle: Over 2.5 goals and BTTS: Yes driven by Cosne's five-match cup scoring streak and Sedan's road scoring surge (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Contingency Angle: 1:1 regulation draw if Cosne replicate their home Regional 1 clean-sheet organization through 90 minutes (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Low)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Two unbeaten R1 leaders clash for a Round of 64 berth.

spf.comment: Covers a narrow 1:2 away victory powered by Sedan's veteran cup attack alongside a 1:1 draw given Cosne's unbeaten home league run, as unverified Regional 1 team sheets prevent locking a single outcome.

over_under.comment: Union Cosnoise's 1.99 decayed cup goals for and 1.62 decayed goals against combine with Sedan's prolific road attack to point toward three or more goals.

btts.comment: Cosne have scored in five consecutive cup ties and lead their R1 group at home, while Sedan's attacking quality should breach a host conceding 1.62 decayed cup goals per match.

score.comment: 1:2 captures Sedan's second-half clinical edge against a scoring home side, while 1:1 reflects Cosne's disciplined home league structure forcing penalties.

goals.comment: Three goals aligns with our 1:2 primary projection in an open cup battle, with two goals covering a tighter 1:1 stalemate.

bqc.comment: A tight opening 45 minutes should keep scores level at half-time before Sedan either pull away late (Draw-Loss) or Cosne hold out for 90 minutes (Draw-Draw).
